title: Sip Endpoint
description: SIP Endpoint that represents a device that can make or receive VOIP phone calls.

guid.description: Unique identifier of the SIP Endpoint.

createdOn.description: Date and time on which the SIP Endpoint was created.

hostname.description: Hostname of the SIP Endpoint, when given, the IP address should be left blank.

ipAddress.description: External IP address of the SIP Endpoint, when given, the hostname should be left blank.

port.description: Port number of the SIP Endpoint, when set to 0 any port number will be used.

subnetMask.description: Subnet mask of the SIP Endpoint.

isTrusted.description: Whether authentication is required for the SIP endpoints to use the SIP Account or not. It is not recommended to set this to true.
